summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GreatWorks Foundation NGO website. Backend APIs mostly functional (91.3% success rate), frontend fully functional with excellent UI/UX. All major features tested including homepage, donation forms, volunteer applications, contact forms, admin dashboard, and annual reports.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error due to MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks donation form submissions from frontend

integration_issues.issue: Form submits but backend returns 500 error due to ObjectId serialization

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section, programs, impact counters, and stories
Navigation between all pages (Home, Donate, Get Involved, Contact, Admin)
Volunteer application form submission works correctly
Admin dashboard loads with all tabs functional
Blog post creation form in admin
Calendar functionality on Get Involved page
All form validations and UI interactions
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue in donations endpoint (/api/donations) - the error occurs when trying to serialize ObjectId objects in the response. Consider using string UUIDs instead of MongoDB ObjectIds for better JSON serialization.
